answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose Model-based Preference Optimization (MPO), a novel and straightforward approach that leverages the model's inherent summarization capabilities ... using different decoding strategies.

answer_2.quote: For Faithfulness, we used Align-Score and FactCC. To measure Relevance, we employed BARTScore and BS-FACT. Lastly, to evaluate Similarity, we used ROUGE-L.

answer_3.quote: We conducted win rate evaluation based on GPT-3.5. For details on the win rate prompts, refer to Appendix A.1.

answer_4.quote: Human Evaluation To assess whether the automatic score (i.e., AlignScore) aligns with human preference, we conducted human evaluations on 100 samples from the TL;DR dataset across two groups.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators were asked to choose which summary (MPO vs. DPO) was better for each sample.
